import struct
b=open('doomgeneric_mips','rb').read()
# Count opcode distribution in executable segment
text_start=0x400000; text_off=0; text_filesz=353556
counts={}
cop1=0
for off in range(0, text_filesz, 4):
    w=struct.unpack_from('<I', b, text_off+off)[0]
    op=w>>26
    counts[op]=counts.get(op,0)+1
    if op==0x11: cop1+=1
    if op==0 and (w&0x3f)==0x0c: # syscall
        pass
print('opcode distribution (op,count):')
for op,c in sorted(counts.items()):
    print(f'  0x{op:02x} ({op:2d}): {c}')
print('COP1 (float) instructions:', cop1)
# Find syscall instructions
print('syscall instructions:')
for off in range(0, text_filesz, 4):
    w=struct.unpack_from('<I', b, text_off+off)[0]
    if (w>>26)==0 and (w&0x3f)==0x0c:
        print(f'  addr=0x{text_start+off:08x} off=0x{off:x} w=0x{w:08x} code={w>>6&0xfffff}')
